_comment: The single source of truth for what this project needs and what it has
actually been run on. `make doctor` reports against it, `make
requirements-check` enforces it, and the tables in docs/dependencies.md are
generated from it -- so a version claim cannot drift between the build, the
Three fields carry the honesty, and they are deliberately separate:
tested      versions actually run here, with the evidence that was run.
supported   the range accepted without comment. Wider than `tested`,
because refusing every version nobody has gotten round to
trying would be a worse lie than admitting the gap.
unsupported known-bad ranges, each with the reason it is known bad.
A version inside `supported` but outside `tested` is reported as accepted
but untested, which is what it is. Do not widen `tested` without running
the evidence named beside it and recording the version here.

core.label: Core: build, simulation, and component tests
core.doc: Everything the ISS, Verilator simulation and target images need.

kernel.label: Kernel: aXos S/U-mode boot checks
kernel.doc: The three-platform and aXos checks; needs a current QEMU.

browser.label: Browser tier (optional)
browser.doc: Compiles the Verilated model to WebAssembly. Load-bearing for nothing: no evidence claim rests on it.

analysis.label: Analysis and second toolchain (optional)
analysis.doc: Static analysis, sanitizers, fuzzing, and the LLVM build.

riscv-gcc.name: RISC-V GCC
riscv-gcc.note: The ISA spelling is probed rather than assumed: GCC before 12 rejects the explicit _zicsr spelling and GCC 12+ requires it, so mk/toolchain.mk compiles a CSR instruction and keeps what survives.

verilator.name: Verilator

tested.evidence: the full suite; the recorded baseline for every timing number
make verify-smoke, make component-test, and sim-role-loopback/sim-bram cycle-identical to 4.038 on cpu_perf (42,978 cycles, checksum 0xe9266745)

verilator.note: Releases 5 and later report component-API package constants as UNUSEDPARAM and make warnings fatal under -Wall; sim/soc and sim/web pass -Wno-UNUSEDPARAM on 5+ for that reason. Those constants are intentional component API, not dead elaborated hardware.

python.name: Python
python.use: Configuration resolution, test generation, and runners
python.note: 3.10 is the floor because the tools use match statements and 3.10-era typing; no third-party packages are required by the build itself.

qemu.name: QEMU (qemu-system-riscv32)

unsupported.reason: the packaged 6.2 cannot run the PMP-less S/U-mode aXos checks

qemu.missing_hint: the three-platform and aXos checks are skipped without it

unsupported.reason: Ubuntu 22.04's 0.9 rejects axcore_pkg.sv with a TOK_TYPEDEF parser error

sby.name: SymbiYosys
sby.note: `sby --version` prints no parseable version, so presence is all this reports.

emscripten.name: Emscripten
emscripten.use: Compiles the Verilated model to WebAssembly
emscripten.note: Installed through emsdk rather than apt, and sourced per shell. tools/web.sh sources ~/emsdk/emsdk_env.sh itself when emcc is not already on PATH.
emscripten.missing_hint: not on PATH; if emsdk is installed, source ~/emsdk/emsdk_env.sh (docs/toolchain.md). tools/web.sh does this itself.

node.name: Node
node.use: Headless WASM boot, the side-by-side comparison, and the page check

tested.evidence: make web-check, make web-compare-check, make web-page-check
the Node emsdk ships; make web-check

node.note: 18 is the floor because the runners use top-level await in ES modules and String.matchAll.
node.missing_hint: emsdk ships one; the browser checks are skipped without it

browser.name: Chromium or Edge
browser.use: Renders the console, comparison, and experiment-handoff pages for make web-page-check

probe._comment: Probed by presence, never by running it: a Windows browser invoked with --version from WSL attaches to the user's running session instead of printing a version. page_check.mjs reads this list, so there is one copy of it.

browser.note: Any Chromium-family browser with --headless=new and --dump-dom. The check skips rather than fails when none is found, and never terminates a browser process it did not start.
browser.missing_hint: make web-page-check skips rather than fails; AX_BROWSER picks one

ruff.name: ruff
ruff.use: Python lint stage of make static-analysis
ruff.missing_hint: that stage of make static-analysis is skipped

clang.name: clang
clang.use: Second toolchain (TOOLCHAIN=llvm) and the riscv32 analyzer

cppcheck.name: cppcheck
cppcheck.use: Host C++ stage of make static-analysis
cppcheck.missing_hint: that stage of make static-analysis is skipped

shellcheck.name: shellcheck
shellcheck.missing_hint: that stage of make static-analysis is skipped
